integrity: Standalone graph-checking code and its recorded output are provided; research sources are linked, not redistributed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to crown graphs, \(2\le k\le n-1\), minimum-size backbone solutions and single-token jumps; full infinite claims depend on written graph proof, not finite checks. Prior crown connectivity and ordinary connected domination are attributed. Unindexed literature may imply related results; no independent scientific review. Induced vertex connectivity is preserved after fewer than k selected-vertex failures; continued domination after failures is not claimed.
title: A reconfiguration singularity for minimum robust backbones of crown graphs
